description: This file contains a partially implemented class 'DynamoDBStorage' that encapsulates interactions with AWS DynamoDB SDK, including table initialization, CRUD operations, and transaction support. It is part of a namespace that varies based on compilation constants, indicating it is used in different contexts like clustering, persistence, reminders, etc., within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorage
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods to interact with AWS DynamoDB, including table creation, deletion, data CRUD operations, and transactional operations within the Orleans framework.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorage
methods.description: Constructor to initialize DynamoDB storage with configuration parameters and create a DynamoDB client.

methods.name: InitializeTable
methods.description: Creates a DynamoDB table if it doesn't exist, or updates it if it does, based on configuration flags.

methods.name: PutEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a single entry in a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: UpsertEntryAsync
methods.description: Creates or updates an entry in the table, supporting conditional expressions.

methods.name: DeleteEntryAsync
methods.description: Removes an entry from the table based on keys, with optional conditions.

methods.name: DeleteEntriesAsync
methods.description: Batch deletes multiple entries from a DynamoDB table.

methods.name: ReadSingleEntryAsync
methods.description: Reads a single table entry identified by keys and converts it via a resolver function.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Performs a query on the table with key condition expression, supports pagination and index usage.

methods.name: QueryAllAsync
methods.description: Performs paginated query to retrieve all matching entries.

methods.name: ScanAsync
methods.description: Scans the table with a filter expression, returning matching entries.

methods.name: PutEntriesAsync
methods.description: Batch inserts or replaces multiple entries.

methods.name: GetEntriesTxAsync
methods.description: Transactionally retrieves multiple entries based on keys.

methods.name: WriteTxAsync
methods.description: Performs transactional write operations including put, update, delete, and condition checks.
